decision: 10 second stop and go penalty. 3 penalty points (total of 3 for the 12 month period).
fact: Car 4 failed to slow for double waved yellow flags.
offence: Breach of Appendix H, Article 2.5.5 b) of the International Sporting Code and noncompliance with Race Director's Event Notes (item 1, document 3).
penalty: 10 second stop and go penalty. 3 penalty points (total of 3 for the 12 month period).
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry and in-car video evidence. The telemetry and on-board audio clearly showed that the driver of Car 4 did not make any reduction in speed in the yellow sector. The double waved yellow flags and yellow lights were clearly visible to him. Compliance with the yellow flag rules is paramount for the safety of all parties and this requirement is clearly noted in the first item of the Race Director's Event Notes at every event.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 4 Failing To Slow Under Double Waved Yellow Flags
to: The Team Manager, McLaren Formula 1 Team
